metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Shanghai increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Collection: Use Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 NO₂ (tropospheric column). Bands needed: ‘tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density’. 2. Geometry: Shanghai municipality ≈ 31.2°N, 121.5°E; a ~30 km buffer captures the metro area → ee.Geometry.Point([121.5, 31.2]).buffer(30000). 3. Time windows: Pre: 2020-02-10 – 2020-02-25 Post: 2020-04-20 – 2020-05-12 4. Cloud / QA: NO₂ product is daily Level-3 already masked; just drop rows with nodata. 5. Logic: Compute mean tropospheric NO₂ (mol/m²) inside buffer for each period. Check collection sizes first (C1). After reduction check pixel counts (C2). Compare means – if pre < post → A, else B. If any result is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.5, 31.2]).buffer(30000) def no2_mean(start, end, label): col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(shanghai)) n = col.size().getInfo() print(f"{label} images: {n}") if n == 0: print("C1") return None, 0 mean = (col.mean() .multiply(1e6) # scale to μmol/m² for readability .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=shanghai, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .getInfo()) px = (col.mean() .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=shanghai, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .getInfo()) print(f"{label} mean NO₂: {mean:.2f} μmol/m², pixels: {int(px)}") return mean, px pre, px_pre = no2_mean('2020-02-10', '2020-02-25', 'Pre') post, px_post = no2_mean('2020-04-20', '2020-05-12', 'Post') if pre is None or post is None: print("C1") elif px_pre == 0 or px_post == 0: print("C2") elif pre < post: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

shanghai = ee.Geometry.Point([121.5, 31.2]).buffer(30000)

def no2_mean(start, end, label):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
             .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
             .filterDate(start, end)
             .filterBounds(shanghai))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"{label} images: {n}")
    if n == 0:
        print("C1")
        return None, 0
    mean = (col.mean()
              .multiply(1e6)  # scale to μmol/m² for readability
              .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                            geometry=shanghai,
                            scale=3000,
                            maxPixels=1e9)
              .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
              .getInfo())
    px = (col.mean()
            .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                          geometry=shanghai,
                          scale=3000,
                          maxPixels=1e9)
            .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
            .getInfo())
    print(f"{label} mean NO₂: {mean:.2f} μmol/m², pixels: {int(px)}")
    return mean, px

pre, px_pre = no2_mean('2020-02-10', '2020-02-25', 'Pre')
post, px_post = no2_mean('2020-04-20', '2020-05-12', 'Post')

if pre is None or post is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif px_pre == 0 or px_post == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif pre < post:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
